database.stem: After a highly profitable first six months, the restaurant’s profits for the second half of the year were a great -------.
database.raw_text:
After a highly profitable first six months, the restaurant’s profits for the second
half of the year were a great -------.
(A) disappoints
(B) disappointed
(C) disappointing
(D) disappointment
database.explanation:
主系表结构中，名词和形容词可作表语，表语一般说明主语
的身份、特征、属性或状态。在本题中，主语是the restaurant’s
profits，横线前有冠词和形容词 (a great)，因此最恰当的是 (D)
disappointment。
